title: What to Know About the AI-Triggered Cybersecurity Crisis
summary: PHP, a technology that underpins up to 70% of the world's websites, is under threat after a critical memory-handling flaw dubbed PHP2Shell was disclosed that could let attackers take control of affected systems. The US cybersecurity agency CISA urged companies to patch immediately or take vulnerable systems offline, and the tech industry is racing to deploy fixes.

title: Meta's Hunt for AI Capital Strikes a Raw Nerve on Wall Street
summary: Meta's search for new capital to fund its AI buildout unsettled investors, contributing to a sharp market reaction. The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 2.6%, while Treasury yields recorded their biggest drop since 2023.

title: Cyber Investors Don't Know What to Do With Their AI Worries
summary: AI is creating new security risks and lifting demand for protection, but it also exposes cybersecurity stocks to swings in sentiment around the technology. Shares of the five largest US cybersecurity companies all fell by double digits last week, far outpacing the broader selloff, before some began recovering losses.

title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion to New Mexico in Data Privacy Case
summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta Platforms to pay the state $25 billion, weeks after a jury found the company deceived users about its data-privacy practices, its efforts against hate speech and misinformation, and its handling of a third-party app tied to the 2018 Cambridge Analytica breach. Meta's chief legal officer said he is confident the company will prevail on appeal.

title: SpaceX Takes Conglomerate-Building to Sci-Fi Extremes
summary: A Heard on the Street column argues that Elon Musk's mix of businesses under SpaceX will be a maze for investors to evaluate. The piece frames the company's expanding set of ventures as conglomerate-building taken to an extreme.

title: SB Energy Considers Waiting Until December or Later for an IPO
summary: SB Energy is weighing postponing its IPO to December or even next year, later than its earlier September target. The delay adds to signs of a stalled IPO market.

title: Datadog Offered to Buy Security Startup 'Upwind' For Nearly $4 Billion
summary: Datadog has offered close to $4 billion to acquire Upwind, a cloud security startup, according to The Information. The offer would be a major push by the observability vendor into cloud security.

title: Salesforce Wants a Fee Every Time an AI Agent Touches Its Software
summary: Starting around November, Salesforce plans to require customers to register external AI agents, such as Claude, as a step toward charging a fee for each action an agent takes in its apps. Atlassian, Workday, ServiceNow and Datadog are building similar tollgates as software vendors test whether agent fees can offset a possible decline in per-seat subscription revenue. Some consultants say customers may move data outside Salesforce to avoid the charges, and pricing has not yet been announced.

title: Utopai Becomes a Unicorn as Video AI Takes Off
summary: Utopai, a four-year-old AI film studio, has reached a valuation of $1 billion or more, and investors are reportedly already offering up to three times that. The deal highlights strong investor appetite for video AI.

title: Nokia and Nvidia Say AI-RAN Hype Is Justified as Nokia Touts Q3 AI Gains
summary: Nokia CEO Justin Hotard pointed to a boom in AI and cloud product sales in Q3 and said the vendor is well placed for growing infrastructure demand. Nokia and Nvidia executives told the MWL Podcast that close to 20 operators are lined up for lab and commercial AI-RAN trials.

title: AT&T CEO Stankey Argues Scale Matters in Satellite Direct-to-Device
summary: On the Q3 earnings call, AT&T CEO John Stankey outlined the advantages he sees over a potential SpaceX direct-to-device service. He cited AT&T's larger holdings of low-band spectrum, its scaled network and its ability to serve customers inside buildings.

title: Zuckerberg Claims Muse Agent Has Hit 10M Users
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said on the Q3 earnings call that the company plans to expand its Muse personal agent and charge businesses for transactions it handles. He said the agent has reached 10 million users.

title: RBC's AI Chief Sounds the Alarm Over AI Agents
summary: Bruce Ross, RBC's AI chief, says the bank is concerned about letting AI agents access customer accounts and move money without the right safeguards in place.
